recent_history.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of available daily 06:00 PKT reported Marala inflow readings, converted from cusecs to m3/s; one reading per day
recent_history.limitations: Partial-month means average available readings only, not a complete monthly mean or a continuous daily mean. Missing months are null; no model values or interpolation are used.
